branch_semantics.branch_A_and_B: Evaluator-only arbitrary structural labels for two nonempty disjoint graph-defined action-equivalence classes at the scored future branch point.
branch_semantics.carrier_visibility: Branch class membership and A/B labels have no directed path to z0, transition features, F, G, eligibility, arm assignment, replacement, tuning, or candidate action scoring.
branch_semantics.evaluator_opening_rule: For every family and arm, the exact candidate-action whole-action score map must be sealed before evaluator-only A/B class membership is used for aggregation. Opening A/B membership cannot trigger any rescore, model call, state update, action execution, family filtering, or parameter choice.
branch_semantics.orientation_rule: No branch is designated preferred, correct, target, oracle, optimal, donor, or reference. Final V4 statistics are invariant to exchanging the complete A and B class labels.

confirmation_rule.failure_scope: A technically valid confirmation failure refutes this exact V4 endpoint+native-2048 realization claim only; it is not a universal null for all dynamic predictive-state architectures.
support_requires: C_static positives >=22/33 with conservative exact randomized-slot p<=0.05
C_permuted positives >=22/33 with conservative exact randomized-slot p<=0.05
confirmation_rule.support_scope: Exact frozen native-2048 realization, model/runtime later bound without drift, fixed graph/task cohorts only. Supports ordered-dynamics-specific branch-preference displacement magnitude; not route correctness, branch semantic identity, end-task success, or superpopulation prevalence.

fixed_cohort_randomization_inference.assignment_basis: Each family already has an independently frozen uniform six-arm-to-six-isolated-slot assignment. For the static component, condition on all slot outcomes, the NO_CARRY slot, the unordered pair of slots assigned ALIGNED/STATIC_REPEAT, and all other labels; swapping ALIGNED and STATIC_REPEAT is equiprobable and negates C_static. The same argument holds for ALIGNED/TRANSITION_PERMUTED and C_permuted.
fixed_cohort_randomization_inference.component_test: Conservative exact paired randomized-slot sign test: count families with C_component>0; valid C=0 is nonpositive; require >=22/33, giving p<=0.04007165622897446 under the corresponding sharp null.
fixed_cohort_randomization_inference.global_test: Intersection-union test: BOTH static and permuted components must pass at alpha=0.05. No independence between co-primary component tests is required.

planning_power_sensitivity.joint_power_lower_bound_method: Frechet lower bound max(0,p_static+p_permuted-1), with no co-primary dependence assumption.
planning_power_sensitivity.minimality: n=33 remains the smallest denominator when each component uses its exact alpha<=0.05 Binomial(n,0.5) critical count and the q=.75 planning alternative; deterministic exhaustive n=1..32 verification is required.

fixed_cohort_randomization_inference.sharp_null_permuted: For every fixed family and isolated slot, replacing ALIGNED_RECURSION with TRANSITION_PERMUTED (and vice versa) leaves the sealed branch-score outcome unchanged, with all other arm labels/slot identities fixed.
fixed_cohort_randomization_inference.sharp_null_static: For every fixed family and isolated slot, replacing ALIGNED_RECURSION with STATIC_REPEAT (and vice versa) leaves the sealed branch-score outcome unchanged, with all other arm labels/slot identities fixed.
fixed_cohort_randomization_inference.why_binomial_bound_remains_valid: Under each component sharp null, within each fixed family the randomized ALIGNED/comparator label orientation makes a strictly positive contrast probability <=1/2 (ties reduce it). Independent pre-outcome family assignment draws therefore make the positive-count tail stochastically no larger than Binomial(33,0.5), without any graph-family outcome iid assumption.

orientation_invariant_endpoint.branch_swap_invariance: If A and B are exchanged, every R_g changes sign while every D_g and every C contrast is unchanged.
orientation_invariant_endpoint.displacement: D_g = abs(R_g - R_NO_CARRY) for every arm g; D_NO_CARRY = 0.
orientation_invariant_endpoint.interpretation: D_g is the unsigned change in graph-branch log-mass ratio relative to the no-carry policy at the same family. It measures preference displacement magnitude, not movement toward a correct branch.
orientation_invariant_endpoint.pairwise_arm_swap_antisymmetry: Holding NO_CARRY and all other arm-slot labels fixed, exchanging ALIGNED_RECURSION with comparator X exchanges D_ALIGNED and D_X, so C_X changes sign exactly. This licenses the retained pairwise randomized-slot sign test under the corresponding Fisher sharp null.
orientation_invariant_endpoint.tie_rule: Exact C=0 is a valid tie and is counted nonpositive. A family is never dropped or replaced because of a tie.

practical_effect_guards.effect_interpretation: Let Q_g=exp(R_g) be the arbitrary A-to-B branch-class mass ratio and U_g=max(Q_g/Q_NO_CARRY,Q_NO_CARRY/Q_g)=exp(D_g). Then exp(C_X)=U_ALIGNED/U_X. A 0.05-nat median C_X floor means ALIGNED has at least exp(0.05)=1.0512710963760241 times the comparator's unsigned branch-mass-ratio displacement factor relative to NO_CARRY at the median family. This is neither a raw probability ratio nor a correctness-direction claim.

semantic_repair.claim_boundary: A future PASS can support ordered-dynamics-specific branch-preference displacement under the exact frozen realization. It cannot establish task-correct route choice, semantic branch identity, or end-task success.
semantic_repair.mechanistic_question: Does temporally ALIGNED recurrent transition state cause a larger change in future branch preference than matched static exposure and temporally permuted recurrence, under the exact frozen six-arm graph-fork design?
semantic_repair.rejected_v3_orientation: V3 used a directed graph-branch margin whose prose called one class correct and the other opposing, but no accepted authority establishes such task correctness.
semantic_repair.why_not_model_own_reference: No new model-own preferred/reference branch is introduced. This avoids converting z0/base-policy preference into correctness or adding a new source-binding prerequisite.

whole_action_scoring.candidate_set: Exactly the frozen candidate action strings at the future scored branch point. No candidate may be added, removed, relabeled, or rescored after evaluator classes are opened.
whole_action_scoring.class_requirements: A and B must each map to at least one exactly scored candidate action and remain disjoint; missing, duplicate, nonfinite, or unmatched class/action scores are TECHNICAL_INVALID_ENTIRE_SPLIT with no family replacement.
whole_action_scoring.logsumexp: For each class, sort exact action strings lexicographically; read finite FLOAT64 whole-action logscores in that order; compute m=max(scores), then m+log(sum(exp(score-m))) with deterministic left-to-right FLOAT64 accumulation.
whole_action_scoring.score: For each arm g and candidate action a, use the already-contracted sealed whole-action logscore produced by the future scorer/runtime binding. NO_CARRY uses its sealed base-policy whole-action logscore; carry arms use their sealed contracted G-adjusted whole-action logscore. This V4 repair does not bind model/runtime bytes.
whole_action_scoring.structural_margin: R_g = LSE_g(A) - LSE_g(B). R_g is an evaluator coordinate only; its sign has no semantic meaning. Exchanging A and B maps every R_g to -R_g.
